title: Illustrative cold-connection setup budget
method: Synthetic RTT is 60 ms. The model counts two RTTs before a request for TCP plus TLS 1.3 and one for QUIC, giving 120 and 60 ms. It excludes DNS, retries, resumption, early data, server processing and connection reuse; this is not a page-speed benchmark.
alt: Illustrative cold-connection setup budget. TCP plus TLS 1.3: 120 milliseconds; QUIC full handshake: 60 milliseconds. Illustrative values.
